title: Slash customer stories
description: A left-aligned serif heading with an italic figure over a row of customer video tiles with 12px corners: the first is wide and full colour, the rest narrow, greyed and dimmed, each captioned with a portrait, name and role over a dark fade. Hovering a tile grows it over 700ms and reveals its figures, an industry chip and a story link underneath. Phones get one full-width tile at a time in a swipe row.
notes: CSS only (`:has()` hover logic); the original rotates the large tile on a timer, this grows it on hover/focus
media and avatar slots take real video or images; dim surfaces stand in when empty
name: slash-customers
